# build-all exits 1 for an engine built inside node_modules/neo.mjs

## Context

Found by the C1 content pre-read for #19047 AC-4 ([receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19047#issuecomment-5788219268)). `neomjs/pages` deploys by running `npm run build-all` with `cwd: node_modules/neo.mjs` (`pages/buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs:154-158`) and exits on any non-zero status. With the engine packed from `dev@526b65e0ee`, the `dist/esm` step fails:

```
dist/esm: 3214 import(s) still address the workspace engine at node_modules/neo.mjs:
```

Every import in the tree is flagged, `./` siblings included: `src` 1,344, `examples` 1,090, `apps` 730, `docs` 47, `ServiceWorker.mjs` 3.

The guard came in with #17921 / #17932 (`34499f737b`, 2026-08-31). No release tag contains it, so 13.1.0's deploy never ran it. v13.2's deploy will.

## The Problem

`findUnresolvableImports` (`buildScripts/util/esmDistTransforms.mjs:450`) fails an import when `addressesSourceEngine(resolved)` is true, and `resolved` is the import target's **absolute** path (`buildScripts/build/esmodules.mjs:165`). `addressesSourceEngine` matches any path containing `/node_modules/neo.mjs/`.

- In a workspace, that segment appears only when an import reaches the workspace's own engine: the two-graph defect the guard exists for.
- In an engine built in place inside a consumer's `node_modules/neo.mjs`, the build root itself contains the segment, so every resolved path does.

The check is keyed to where the build runs, not to where the import points.

## The Architectural Reality

- `esmodules.mjs` sets `root = path.resolve()` (the cwd) and derives `insideNeo` from the package name. Pages' flow is `insideNeo: true` with root `<pages>/node_modules/neo.mjs`.
- The guard's second arm, `addressesSourceEngine(specifier)`, reads the specifier as written and does not depend on the root.
- The resolved-path arm still earns its place. It catches a specifier that names the engine only after normalisation (`node_modules/./neo.mjs/…`). The text arm misses that form. `rewriteImportPaths` does too, because it keys on the literal `/node_modules/neo.mjs/`, so it leaves the import pointing at the workspace engine.
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/esmDistTransforms.spec.mjs` pins the pure function. `esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs` drives the real `esmodules.mjs` over synthetic workspaces. None of those workspaces sits under a `node_modules/neo.mjs` path, which is why no spec saw this.

**Measured A/B, same in-place tree (3,503 emitted modules):** the `526b65e0ee` guard exits 1 with 3,214 flagged. Judging the resolved path relative to the build root exits 0 in 3.35 s. With that one change, pages' full `build-all` exits 0 in 36 s.

## The Fix

- `findUnresolvableImports(modules, exists, resolve, root)` judges the resolved-path arm on `path.relative(root, resolved)`. The root's own location is never evidence. Everything below and beside it is judged as before, so a hoisted `../node_modules/neo.mjs/…` still matches.
- `esmodules.mjs` passes its `root`.
- Specs:
  - `esmDistTransforms`: an in-place sibling import reports nothing (red on today's code).
  - A control: an in-place import that really names `node_modules/neo.mjs` still fails as `engine-identity`.
  - A normalisation arm that pins why the resolved-path arm stays.
  - `esmWorkspaceBuild`: the real script, with cwd under `…/node_modules/neo.mjs`, exits 0 (red today).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: An engine built in place inside a `node_modules/neo.mjs` directory builds `dist/esm` with exit 0 when its imports resolve. A real-script arm pins this and reds on today's code.
- [ ] AC-2: Identity is still enforced for such a build and for workspaces. An import that addresses `node_modules/neo.mjs` below or beside the root fails as `engine-identity`, including one that names it only after normalisation.
- [ ] AC-3 (receipt): pages' layout (`main@1847ca65`, engine packed from the fix head) runs `build-all` past the `dist/esm` step. Any later failure is reported on #19047 as a defect of its own.

## Out of Scope

- The rest of #19047 AC-4: topology, devindex, and regenerating the portal indexes.
- Containment for in-place builds: an emitted import reaching the root's own `src/` outside `dist/esm`. It is not flagged before this change or after it.

## Related

- #19047 — this blocks its AC-4.
- #17921 / #17932 — where the guard came from. #17942 — its computed-specifier arm.
